question: Where is my order?
answer: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email or SMS. You can use this tracking number on our tracking page to see real-time updates on your shipment status.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery usually takes 3–5 business days within major cities and 5–7 business days for other locations. Delivery times may vary during sales or holidays.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: You can request a return within 7 days of receiving your order. The product must be unused, in original packaging, and with all tags intact. Visit our Returns Policy page for step-by-step instructions.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. The refund will be credited to your original payment method.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and selected digital wallets. All online payments are secured with industry-standard encryption.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available in most locations. Availability may vary depending on your delivery address and order value.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Absolutely. We use SSL encryption and trusted payment gateways to ensure your personal and payment information remains safe and secure.

question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
answer: Orders can be canceled or modified before they are shipped. Please contact our support team as soon as possible to make changes.

question: Do I need an account to place an order?
answer: No, you can place an order as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to track orders, save addresses, and enjoy faster checkout in the future.

question: What if I receive a damaged or incorrect product?
answer: If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please contact our support team within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the product. We’ll arrange a replacement or refund.

question: Are all products authentic?
answer: Yes, we guarantee that all products sold on our platform are 100% authentic and sourced from verified suppliers.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our customer support team via email, live chat, or the Contact Us page. Our team is available to assist you during business hours.
